purpose: Verify Super Admin can create a hostel record
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; no existing hostel with code 'HM001'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; response contains the created hostel with matching fields

purpose: Verify Super Admin can activate and deactivate a hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; hostel 'HM001' exists and is active
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; hostel 'active' flag set to false

purpose: Verify Student can submit an accommodation request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; student_id = 1001; hostel 'HM001' exists
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; accommodation request status = 'Submitted'

purpose: Verify Super Admin can record initial room allotment
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin; accommodation request id = 2001 exists in 'Submitted' state; room 'R101' exists with capacity > 0
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; request status = 'Room Allotted'; room occupancy increased by 1

purpose: Verify Student can view own room allocation history
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001); at least one room assignment exists for the student
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response includes list of assignments with correct room IDs and timestamps

purpose: Verify Caretaker can maintain room availability and occupancy
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker assigned to hostel 'HM001'; room 'R101' exists
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; room capacity updated to 4; occupancy unchanged

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record individual room exchange
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; student A assigned to room R101; student B assigned to room R102; both rooms belong to same hostel
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; assignments swapped; occupancy unchanged; history records exchange event

purpose: Verify Warden can review room assignments and occupancy patterns
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden assigned to hostel 'HM001'; multiple assignments exist
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response contains assignment list with occupancy summary

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record attendance for a student
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; student_id 1005 enrolled
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; attendance record stored

purpose: Verify Student can view own attendance record
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1005); attendance record for 2026-11-22 exists
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response shows attendance status 'present'

purpose: Verify Attendance procedure scope is respected (no out‑of‑scope update)
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; attendance record id = 3001 exists
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; update not allowed per specification

purpose: Verify Student can submit a leave request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001); no pending leave request
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; leave request status = 'Submitted'

purpose: Verify Caretaker can approve a leave request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker assigned to student's hostel; leave request id = 4001 in 'Submitted' state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; leave request status = 'Approved'

purpose: Verify leave records are retained and visible to Warden
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; leave request id = 4001 approved
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response includes full leave history with approval timestamp

purpose: Verify external leave policy is not enforced inside HM
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; leave request with policy‑specific field omitted
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; request accepted without policy validation

purpose: Verify Student can submit a complaint
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001)
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; complaint status = 'Submitted'

purpose: Verify Caretaker can resolve a complaint
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; complaint id = 5001 in 'Submitted' state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; complaint status = 'Resolved'; event appended to history

purpose: Verify complaints are scoped to hostels only
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; attempt to submit complaint with hostel_id referencing non‑hostel entity
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; validation error indicating invalid hostel scope

purpose: Verify Student can submit a guest‑room booking request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001); guest room 'G101' available
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; booking status = 'Submitted'

purpose: Verify Caretaker can approve a guest‑room booking request
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; booking id = 6001 in 'Submitted' state; room available for requested period
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; booking status = 'Approved'

purpose: Verify Student can view own guest‑room booking status
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001); booking id = 6001 exists
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response shows status 'Approved'

purpose: Verify Student can submit an extended‑stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Student (student_id 1001)
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; extended‑stay status = 'Submitted'

purpose: Verify Warden can approve an extended‑stay request
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; extended‑stay id = 7001 in 'Submitted' state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; extended‑stay status = 'Approved'

purpose: Verify fine record creation by Caretaker
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; student_id 1001
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; fine record stored

purpose: Verify fine payment is out of scope (negative test)
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; fine id = 8001 exists
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found or 403 Forbidden; payment endpoint not implemented

purpose: Verify Caretaker can create inventory item
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; item_name = "Projector"
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; inventory item stored

purpose: Verify procurement is out of scope (negative test)
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found; endpoint not available

purpose: Verify Warden can create guard‑shift record
preconditions: Authenticated as Warden; shift_date = "2026-12-01"
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; guard‑shift stored

purpose: Verify security admin scope is not exposed (negative test)
preconditions: Authenticated as Student
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; endpoint not accessible

purpose: Verify Caretaker can publish a notice
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker assigned to hostel 'HM001'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; notice status = 'Draft'

purpose: Verify Student can view published notices
preconditions: Authenticated as Student; notice id = 10001 is published and visible to student's hostel
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; notice details returned

purpose: Verify report generation endpoint works for Super Admin
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; response contains aggregated occupancy data

purpose: Validate advanced analytics endpoint is not exposed (negative)
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found

purpose: Validate notification production is blocked until contract approved
preconditions: Authenticated as System; attempt to enqueue notification event
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; feature blocked per specification

purpose: Validate Student access is limited to assigned hostel
preconditions: Authenticated as Student assigned to hostel 'HM001'; attempt to access hostel 'HM002' data
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found

purpose: Validate Super Admin has institution‑level access
preconditions: Authenticated as Super Admin
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; list of all hostels returned

purpose: Validate time‑bound role validity is enforced only when dates configured
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker; role binding for Warden has start_date in future
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; binding returned as inactive (not yet effective)

purpose: Validate new role holder can view pending records after reassignment
preconditions: Care taker role reassigned from user 2001 to user 2002; pending complaint id = 5001 belongs to hostel 'HM001'
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; pending complaint appears for new caretaker

purpose: Validate RBAC restricts access to unrelated hostels
preconditions: Authenticated as Caretaker for hostel 'HM001'; attempt to read hostel 'HM002' data
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found
